title: Full body · 19 September
label: 40-MINUTE FULL-BODY STRENGTH
coachNote: 40 minutes in the gym. Your walk is the general warm-up; do a light ramp-up set before the first loaded movements. Keep working sets around RPE 7–8, roughly 2–3 good reps in reserve. Rest 75–90 seconds on the first four movements and about 60 seconds on calves/core. Finish with sleds. Mike Tyson push-ups are saved for a future rotation rather than added today.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.note: Start at 20 kg and move toward 24 kg only if the first set is crisp and comfortable.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.note: Weight is per dumbbell. If 26 kg × 10 is clean with 2–3 reps in reserve, record it and we can progress next time.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.note: Use clean controlled reps; don't chase the heavier setting if form changes.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.note: Choose a comfortable pair after a light practice set. Record weight per dumbbell.

exercises.name: Standing calf raises
exercises.note: Controlled full range: pause at the top and lower slowly. Prefer single-leg if you can maintain clean form.

exercises.name: Hanging knee / leg raises
exercises.note: Use the hardest controlled version you can perform without swinging; progressively straighten the legs.

exercises.name: Sled push
exercises.note: One set is 10 m out + 10 m back. Keep these strong but controlled; record the actual added load.
